'''Chris Mirhva''' (also published as '''Chris Mirva''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 AugustaCon EPP Overdrive (Day 1)]] in October 2000 with EPP Vader, Yavin 4 Forest, according to Paul Myers's and Landon Sommer's tournament reports.<ref name="tr-d1379">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-jabronicon-2000-pauld1379/ jabronicon-2000-paul], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 25 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-jabronicon-2000-pauld1379/ GitHub Pages].</ref><ref name="tr-d1385" />
